title: PARANORMASIGHT Spinoff Manga Listed to End With 2nd Volume
content: Retailers are listing the second compiled book volume of Hinase Momoyama 's PARANORMASIGHT: File 25 - Reikan Shōjō Kurosuzu Mio no Kaigō (PARANORMASIGHT: File 25 - The Chance Encounter of Psychic Girl Mio Kurosuzu) spinoff manga as the final one for the series. The volume will ship on August 6.
author: ANN

title: Abrams ComicArts' Kana Licenses Qtonagi's Hotel Astrology Book
content: Abrams ComicArts ' Kana imprint announced on Monday that it has licensed Qtonagi's Hotel Astrology book and will release it in fall 2027. The book uses illustrations to show astrology through horoscopes, and also includes the 10 planets and their aspects, the 12 astrological houses, and traits from zodiac signs as…
author: ANN

title: Uta no Prince-sama Dolce Vita, Uta no Prince-sama Shining Live Games Announce Release Dates
content: The staff for the Uta no Prince-sama franchise announced on Tuesday that the Nintendo Switch version of the Uta no Prince-sama♪ Dolce Vita game will launch in 2027, and KLab 's Utano Princesama Shining Live smartphone game will launch for Switch on December 17.
author: ANN

title: Bleach’s Rumored Hell Arc Sequel Could Finally Make Fans’ Dreams Come True
content: There are major rumors swirling around about Bleach creator Tite Kubo returning to the pages of Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump with an official new arc of the manga , and it could be the sequel that fans have been waiting years to see.
author: ComicBook

title: Sonic Racing CrossWorlds Game Adds Classic Sonic, Crazy Taxi's Axel, Samba de Amigo's Amigo
content: Sega announced during Sonic's Birthday livestream on Tuesday more new free Sega characters for its Sonic Racing CrossWorlds game. Classic Sonic will launch later on Tuesday, Axel from Crazy Taxi will debut in August, and Amigo from Samba de Amigo will join the game in September.
author: ANN

title: CAKE, WEP Partner to Distribute Voltron Franchise
content: Production company CAKE announced on June 15 that it is partnering with entertainment studio World Events Productions(WEP) to distribute 280 episodes of the Voltron animated franchise globally.
author: ANN

title: Mushoku Tensei Season 3 to Debut First Two Episodes in Special Premiere
content: The Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation production committee announced on June 20 that Season 3 will debut with its first two episodes on July 4. The season kicks off the Eris Training Arc , which received a new visual last week.
author: Anime Corner

title: Netflix’s Next Shojo Anime Releases a New Look
content: When it comes to Weekly Shonen Jump, the manga publication routinely creates some of the biggest anime adaptations the world has ever seen. Capitalizing on this fact, Netflix has been carving out a place of its own within the anime world.
author: ComicBook

title: Sonic Frontiers: Definitive Edition Game Announced With Same-Day Release on Switch 2
content: Sega announced during Sonic's Birthday livestream on Tuesday that it has launched Sonic Frontiers - Definitive Edition , an enhanced edition of the Sonic Frontiers game in the Sonic the Hedgehog series, for Nintendo Switch 2.
author: ANN
